'''Monsurra''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] artisan who served as the tailor of the [[Myyydril]] tribe during the years prior to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He was infected by the [[Poltur Virus]].
